build_equivariant_layer_norm: build a python module to create an EquivariantLayerNormArray for normalizing equivariant features of shape N sphere_basis C
build_spherical_harmonics_layer_norm: build a python module to create an EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics that normalizes L=0 separately and L>0 across all m components
build_rms_norm_spherical_harmonics: build a python module to create an EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 that normalizes across all m components with optional centering and degree balancing
build_degree_layer_scale: build a python module to create an EquivariantDegreeLayerScale that scales equivariant features by degree similar to CaiT layer scale
create_normalization_layer_factory: create a python module to use get_normalization_layer factory function to instantiate layer_norm layer_norm_sh or rms_norm_sh normalization layers
